text:
Lia (PM): Quick sync — planning next quarter console observability roadmap. Customers are pressuring on three things: dashboards (cost + latency breakdowns), tracing hooks (sampling + easy span linking), and error analytics (root-cause / regression alerts). I want to align on MVP surface and launch acceptance gates. Proposal below, pls react with picks or ✂️ if we need cuts.

Maya (Product): +1 on making cost visibility first-class. Sales says Acme & FinSafe cite cost-per-route as a purchase blocker. :warning:

Devin (Eng): Storage + ingestion cost is the main engineering constraint. We can ship a lightweight metric-only dashboard quickly, but full per-span tracing with 30d retention is expensive. Suggest phased approach.

Sanjay (SRE): Agree. We should set clear SLOs: dashboard load <200ms, trace capture add <15ms p95 to request latency when sampling on. Those numbers affect infra sizing.

Lia (PM): Proposal: MVP = 1) cost-by-route widget (hosted + dedicated views), 2) tracing hooks: low-overhead sampling + span attach API, 3) error-regressions alerts (per-service anomaly detection). Launch gates: end-to-end demo with Acme dataset, perf tests meeting SLOs, and retention/PII controls doc. Anyone object?

Maya (Product): No objections. Ask: can we scope cost widget to top-10 routes first? That buys time on backend aggregation.

Devin (Eng): Top-10 routes is fine. For tracing hooks, propose default sampling config:

```
sampling:
  global_rate: 0.01  # 1% overall
  priority_routes:
    - /v1/generate
    - /v1/embeddings
  max_spans_per_trace: 50
```

That keeps storage bounded and covers hot routes. We can let customers opt-in to higher sampling on Dedicated.

Sanjay (SRE): For error analytics, we need deterministic signal sets. I suggest: aggregation by route+model-version, anomaly score threshold (0.85), and alert burn-in to avoid noise. Also we must provide a way to tie alerts to telemetry p95/regression tests.

Lia (PM): Good. Two product tradeoffs to confirm: retention windows (14d vs 30d) and sampling defaults (1% vs 0.1%). Customers like FinSafe want longer retention + audit logs. We should capture their ask for Private/Dedicated only? Thoughts?

Maya (Product): Recommend we make 30d standard for Dedicated + Private, 14d for Hosted to control costs. Expose an upgrade path in the UI with cost estimate. :money_with_wings:

Devin (Eng): Implementation note — UI upgrade should surface estimated monthly token + trace-storage delta before confirm. Backend: we can leverage prefix/KV caching to avoid re-ingesting repeated request bodies for cost calculations.

Sanjay (SRE): Also add retention controls and KMS metadata for Private customers (FinSafe requirement). Must be in scope for launch to close those deals.

Lia (PM): OK consensus forming. Action items:
- Lia: draft acceptance criteria and runbook for demo with Acme (due Tue)
- Devin: spike proof-of-concept for trace-hooks sampling config and perf impact (due Fri)
- Maya: customer impact doc + pricing sketch for retention tiers (due Wed)
- Sanjay: SLO test plan + infra cost estimate for 14d vs 30d (due Fri)

Devin (Eng): I'll drop a small benchmark in the thread when I have numbers.

observability-bot: deploy-bot: Canary of "trace-hooks-lite" rolled out to staging at 1762411000, job: canary-traces-01, status: running.

Maya (Product): Nice. If canary looks good can we schedule a customer demo window with Acme next week?

Devin (Eng): Can do. Preliminary perf: add ~6-8ms p95 when sampling is enabled on a route at 1% (staging numbers). I'll attach full logs tomorrow.

Sanjay (SRE): FYI: estimated monthly cost delta for 14d->30d retention at current sampling = +28% storage. Putting that on the doc. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Lia (PM): Thanks team — I'll synthesize and post the acceptance checklist. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we lock MVP and tickets. :thumbsup:

Maya (Product): :thumbsup:

Devin (Eng): :metal:

Sanjay (SRE): :ok_hand:
